title: Tailnet Connection Helper configuration
description: Administrator configuration delivered through Chrome's managed storage. Set these under the extension's ID in the Admin console field 'Policy for extensions'. Values use the flat form, for example {"companyName": "Acme"}.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Set false to leave Chrome's normal error page in place without uninstalling the extension.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Organisation name shown on the guidance page, for example 'Acme'. Leave unset for neutral wording that names no company.

watchedSuffixes.title: Watched domain suffixes
watchedSuffixes.description: Hostnames or suffixes this extension acts on, for example ['acme.ts.net']. A failed navigation to anything else is ignored and Chrome's own error page is left alone. Defaults to ['ts.net'], which matches every tailnet.

tailnetName.title: Tailnet display name
tailnetName.description: Name shown under the account row in the illustrated Tailscale menu, matching what users actually see in their client.

emailDomain.title: Email domain
emailDomain.description: Domain used to render the example account in the illustration as you@example.com. Illustrative only, no address is read or sent.

supportUrl.title: Support link
supportUrl.description: Where the escalation button sends a user who has already retried. Must be an https, mailto or slack URL. Leave unset to hide the button.

supportLabel.title: Support button label
supportLabel.description: Text on the escalation button. Defaults to 'Ask IT'.

tailscaleDownloadUrl.title: Tailscale download link
tailscaleDownloadUrl.description: Shown to users who have no Tailscale client at all. Defaults to the official download page.

connectHelpUrl.title: Internal runbook link
connectHelpUrl.description: Optional link to your own connection instructions, shown alongside the built-in steps.

controlUrl.title: Connectivity check URL
controlUrl.description: Public endpoint used to tell 'Tailscale is off' apart from 'this network needs a captive portal sign-in'. Fetched no-cors with no user data. Override if your network blocks the default.

logoDataUrl.title: Logo
logoDataUrl.description: Optional logo as a data:image/ URI. Remote URLs are rejected so the page never makes an outbound request.

probeTimeoutMs.title: Probe timeout (ms)
probeTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the local Tailscale check before calling it down. Default 1500.

targetTimeoutMs.title: App reachability timeout (ms)
targetTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the destination app before retrying. Default 4000.

pollIntervalMs.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.description: How often the guidance page rechecks connectivity. Default 2500.

suppressMs.title: Re-show suppression (ms)
suppressMs.description: How long to avoid re-showing the guidance page for the same tab and URL, so pressing Back does not bounce the user forward again. Default 8000.

askItAfterAttempts.title: Attempts before escalation
askItAfterAttempts.description: Number of failed visits to the same URL before the support button appears. Default 2.

strings.title: Copy overrides
strings.description: Replaces the wording for any of the four states. Supports the placeholders {company}, {host}, {error}, {tailnetName} and {exampleEmail}. Override only the states you care about, the rest keep their defaults.

pill.description: Short status label in the chip at the top of the page.

headline.description: Main heading. Placeholders are substituted as plain text.

lede.description: Sentence under the heading explaining what failed.

steps.description: Numbered instructions shown to the user.
